allowed.opencode.ai:443: 1 CONNECT tunnel per run, logged at close; inference succeeded in all 4 runs

network_observations.models_opencode_ai_decision: NOT added. The frozen rule permits adding a hostname only if inference cannot complete without it. Inference completed in 4/4 calibration runs and 4/4 isolation-audit runs with this host denied.

attribution_of_denied_attempts.finding: none of the denied attempts is attributable to agent-initiated research
evidence: every shell command executed by all four agents was enumerated from the traces: not one performs a network operation (no curl, wget, git fetch/ls-remote, npm view, no web tool)
the deny pattern is identical across all four runs regardless of arm or case, at t+~52 s (models.opencode.ai), t+~54 s (registry.npmjs.org) and t+~78 s (github.com), varying by under 6 s
a bare trivial inference with no repository and no test run reproduces models.opencode.ai + registry.npmjs.org denies
`npm test` alone in the workspace with no agent reproduces one registry.npmjs.org deny (npm's update-notifier)
attribution_of_denied_attempts.conclusion: these are runtime background checks by opencode and npm, denied structurally. github.com remains the least directly attributed of the three: it appears only in longer sessions and in no trace command.

network_observations.web_retrieval_during_genuine_repair: 0 attempts. The agents never invoked WebFetch or search during a real repair task, so the critical provider-web-bypass path was exercised by the isolation audit but NOT by calibration.
network_observations.leakage: no run obtained any historical fix information from the network. No INVALID_LEAKAGE.

hidden_evaluator_status.workspace_audit_check: no_hidden_evaluator_material and no_hidden_variant_identifiers passed on all 4 workspaces

resource_findings.reclaimed_before_calibration: ~890 MB (602 MB Homebrew download cache, ~285 MB build-only Go toolchain)
resource_findings.colima_note: the Lima VM disk file only grows; freeing space inside the VM does not return it to the host
resource_findings.calibration_gate: SATISFIED — all four runs and all four hidden evaluations completed with no disk-pressure failure
resource_findings.headline_projection: 20 runs at 60 MB each would need ~1.2 GB of simultaneous workspace space against 1.6 GB free, before VM growth. Workspace retention is therefore OFF by default: only one workspace exists at a time and the patch, trace, proxy log and evaluation are kept instead. This is a decision point to confirm before the headline runs.

calibration_validated: sanitized workspace construction (8/8 audit checks, 4/4 workspaces)
future git history and upstream fixes inaccessible (single commit, no remote, verified by the agents themselves)
CONTROL and TREATMENT prompts differ only by the .repro addition; evidence packs byte-identical per case
model invocation works inside the isolated container (4/4)
timeout behaviour: budget enforced by `timeout`; no run approached it
hidden evaluator runs only after the subject terminates (4/4)
no hidden-evaluator information enters the subject workspace (4/4)
the treatment artifact is genuinely usable by a real agent: 3-4 invocations per treatment run, and both ORIGINAL_FAILURE_REPRODUCED and ORIGINAL_FAILURE_ABSENT were observed
no network-policy bypass appeared under real agent tool usage
not_validated_by_calibration: provider web-retrieval bypass under a genuine repair task: the agents never attempted a web tool, so only the isolation audit exercised that path
timeout handling on a run that actually exhausts the budget: no calibration run came close
behaviour on a case the agent cannot solve: all four calibration runs succeeded
verdict_caveat: READY_FOR_HEADLINE refers to the harness only. Calibration outcomes are never product-value evidence, and all four cases solving in both arms says nothing about the five probe cases.
